exposure: Number of prior cesarean deliveries (three or less vs. four or more)
outcome: Placenta previa with placental invasion anomalies
cohort: 120 patients who underwent cesarean sections between August and November 2015
finding: Women with four or more prior cesarean deliveries did not experience a higher risk of maternal complications compared to those with three or less, except for an increased rate of intra-abdominal adhesions.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of cesarean hysterectomy between patients with three or less prior cesarean deliveries and those with four or more.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was recorded but specific values not stated.
